name: Levi Strauss & Co. (Levi's)
note: Publicly traded apparel company (NYSE: LEVI, per its SEC DEF 14A). Held unrated pending a person's review: the Worker Rights Consortium's June 2024 factory assessment (https://www.workersrights.org/our-work/factory-investigations/ozak) found Levi's supplier Oezak/Kuebrateks in Tuerkiye committed or was complicit in violence, arrests, the retaliatory mass firing of roughly 400 workers and blacklisting after they joined the union BIRTEK-SEN; Levi's called the mass firing a "zero tolerance violation" of its supplier standards, then continued placing orders without the reinstatement it had demanded, and the WRC states there has been no remediation. Whether this supplier-factory record reaches the company itself is for a maintainer to decide. Also pending: a Dutch Clean Clothes Campaign lawsuit over labour-related advertising claims (filed 2026-04-21, cleanclothes.org/news/2026/ccc-announces-court-case-against-levis-for-misleading-claims), not yet a finding.
